verdict: Pass for sampled stills only. The eight matched pairs preserve the spider body position and scale, its changing leg fan and reaching direction, and the sampled background drift. The original Quick, Draw! identity remains recognizable in the uneven open oval and eight thin, angular, unadorned legs. Actual normal-speed playback was unavailable and did not occur; motion is not approved.
must_not_be_lost: Keep the original uneven, slightly open oval, eight sparse angular legs with their irregular lengths and bends, and absence of eyes, face, fill, or added anatomical detail. Preserve the matched body placement/scale and source-derived asymmetrical reach changes. Do not regularize the spider into a symmetric icon.
